Diff format:
- Anchors must have the form '@@ exact existing line @@', including BOTH opening and closing '@@' markers. They move the cursor just after the matching line.
- Consecutive anchors must match consecutive source lines. Use enough context to identify the intended location. Malformed or unmatched anchors reject the patch.

- Lines starting with '-' delete that exact line found forward.
- Lines starting with '+' add a new line at the current cursor.

- All diff lines should start with one of the special characters above and a space following them. Other lines will be completely ignored
